answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 610 Country: India Title: Is insurance of car and house haraam? Question: Is insurance of car and house haraam? Jazakallah Answer ID: 610 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 566/J) According to government law, one has to get the insurance of his car at the time of purchasing. Therefore, it is allowed due to this compulsion. But, the insurance of a house is not permissible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
